annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement français (Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Relance; MESRI; Secrétariat général pour l'investissement)
key_provisions_or_claims: €2.22bn over five years (€1.5bn public) for the second phase of the national AI strategy, with training taking over half of public funds
Massive AI training plan: 2000 undergraduates, 1500 master's students and 200 extra PhDs per year
Aims for 10-15% of the global embedded AI market by 2025, covering connected and autonomous transport and new-generation robotics
€80M public funding for trustworthy AI (Confiance.ai) to prepare industry for EU AI Act high-risk requirements
Frugal AI demonstrators for ecological transition; governance by national AI coordinator and SGPI
annotation.summary_en: France's second-phase national AI strategy (2021-2025, France 2030) allocates €2.22bn to AI talent training, embedded and frugal AI, trustworthy AI and diffusion in the economy. Embodied AI appears through embedded AI, autonomous transport and next-generation robotics, and it anticipates EU AI Act compliance, but it contains no robot-specific governance.
annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale pour l'intelligence artificielle – 2e phase
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence – Phase 2
